description: This file defines the FilesController class, which manages file operations such as upload, download, delete, protect/unprotect, and interactions with UI components in a web application. It handles file actions, file selection, and integrates with various services for file handling and UI feedback.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: Controller class managing file operations such as upload, download, delete, protect/unprotect, and UI interactions within a web application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources and references when the controller is deinitialized.

methods.name: setShowFileContextMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables the display of the file context menu.

methods.name: setShowProtectedOverlay
methods.description: Enables or disables the protected overlay UI.

methods.name: setFileContextMenuLocation
methods.description: Sets the position of the file context menu.

methods.name: reloadAllFiles
methods.description: Reloads the list of all displayable files.

methods.name: reloadAttachedFiles
methods.description: Reloads files attached to the currently selected note.

methods.name: deleteFile
methods.description: Deletes a specified file after user confirmation.

methods.name: attachFileToSelectedNote
methods.description: Attaches a file to the currently selected note.

methods.name: detachFileFromNote
methods.description: Detaches a file from the currently selected note.

methods.name: toggleFileProtection
methods.description: Toggles the protection status of a file.

methods.name: authorizeProtectedActionForFile
methods.description: Checks if an action on a protected file is authorized.

methods.name: renameFile
methods.description: Renames a specified file.

methods.name: handleFileAction
methods.description: Handles various file actions such as attach, detach, delete, download, protect, rename, and preview.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a specified file, showing progress and handling errors.

methods.name: alertIfFileExceedsSizeLimit
methods.description: Alerts user if a file exceeds size limits based on browser capabilities.

methods.name: selectAndUploadNewFiles
methods.description: Opens file selector to upload new files, optionally executing a callback after upload.

methods.name: uploadNewFile
methods.description: Uploads a new file or file handle, with progress feedback and error handling.

methods.name: notifyObserversOfUploadedFileLinkingToCurrentNote
methods.description: Notifies observers that a file has been linked to the current note.

methods.name: deleteFilesPermanently
methods.description: Permanently deletes specified files after user confirmation.

methods.name: setProtectionForFiles
methods.description: Sets protection status for multiple files and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: downloadFiles
methods.description: Downloads multiple files concurrently.
